note: Official-API-only sourcing. No scraping/evasion. Fields marked unverified need confirmation against official docs.

aliexpress.auth: HMAC-MD5 signed form-POST on every request. Credentials: ALIEXPRESS_APP_KEY (app_key param) + ALIEXPRESS_APP_SECRET (signing secret). Every call includes app_key, sign_method='md5', timestamp (Shanghai time), format='json', v='2.0', and a computed sign field. No OAuth token exchange needed — signing is stateless.

searchEndpoint.description: Keyword-based product search via AliExpress Affiliate Open Platform.

keyRequestParams.sort: string — e.g. LAST_VOLUME_DESC (sales volume desc, repo default)
keyRequestParams.ship_to_country: string — ISO country code, e.g. US
keyRequestParams.category_ids: string — comma-joined AE category IDs (optional narrowing)
keyRequestParams.fields: string — comma-joined response fields to include

imageSearchEndpoint.description: Visual similarity search. Two dispatch arms: image_base64+image_format (preprocessed, preferred) or image_url (raw URL, let AE fetch). Returns candidates ranked by visual similarity.

keyRequestParams.image_url: string — URL arm: AE fetches the image
keyRequestParams.product_id: string — set to '0' for discovery mode

aliexpress.affiliateLinks: Two paths. (1) Native AE: method aliexpress.affiliate.link.generate with promotion_link_type='0', source_values=<product URL>, tracking_id — response promotion_links.promotion_link[].promotion_link. (2) Admitad fallback: OAuth2 client_credentials to https://api.admitad.com/token/ (scope: deeplink_generator public_data), then GET https://api.admitad.com/deeplink/{ADMITAD_WEBSITE_ID}/advcampaign/{ADMITAD_ALIEXPRESS_CAMPAIGN_ID}/?ulp=<sourceUrl> — response[0].link. Provider preference controlled by AFFILIATE_PROVIDER env var ('auto'|'admitad').

responseFields.promotion_link: string — pre-baked affiliate link (when API returns one)
responseFields.sale_price: string — base price (currency per target_currency param)
responseFields.lastest_volume: number|string — recent order/sales count (proxy for seller trust)
responseFields.ship_to_days: string|number — estimated shipping days to target country

aliexpress.notes: Already integrated and in production. Credentials required: ALIEXPRESS_APP_KEY, ALIEXPRESS_APP_SECRET, ALIEXPRESS_TRACKING_ID (optional, defaults to 'busted'). Admitad path additionally needs ADMITAD_CLIENT_ID, ADMITAD_CLIENT_SECRET, ADMITAD_WEBSITE_ID, ADMITAD_ALIEXPRESS_CAMPAIGN_ID. Image smartmatch falls back gracefully to null on any failure — never breaks the pipeline.

cjdropshipping.auth: API-key → access-token exchange. Step 1: POST /api2.0/v1/authentication/getAccessToken with JSON body {apiKey: '<CJ_API_KEY>'}. Returns accessToken (15-day lifetime) and refreshToken (180-day lifetime). Server-side caches the same token within a 24-hour window for the same account. Step 2: Pass CJ-Access-Token: <token> header on every subsequent request. Refresh: POST /api2.0/v1/authentication/refreshAccessToken.
cjdropshipping.protocol: HTTPS required. Request/response format: JSON, UTF-8. Auth header: CJ-Access-Token.

searchEndpoint.description: Recommended product search/list endpoint (V2). Keyword search across public CJ catalog.

keyRequestParams.keyWord: string — product name or SKU search term
keyRequestParams.startSellPrice: decimal — minimum price filter in USD (optional)
keyRequestParams.endSellPrice: decimal — maximum price filter in USD (optional)

legacySearchEndpoint.description: Legacy product list endpoint. Retained for back-compat; listV2 is recommended.

responseFields.productImage: string — main image URL (legacy field name)
responseFields.listedNum: int — how many stores have listed this product

affiliateLinks.todo: The CJ API auth page lists a /api2.0/v1/authentication/getAffiliateAccessToken endpoint (#6 in the auth section), but its request parameters, response shape, and relationship to product-level affiliate link generation are not documented in the pages fetched. CJ also runs a separate human-facing affiliate referral program (affiliate.cjdropshipping.com, 2% commission on referred users) that is distinct from product-level affiliate tracking. Confirm via https://developers.cjdropshipping.com/en/api/api2/ whether getAffiliateAccessToken generates trackable product links or is only for the user-referral commission program.
affiliateLinks.humanAffiliateProgram: affiliate.cjdropshipping.com — 2% commission on referred users' orders for 1 year. Not a product-link API.

rateLimits.dailyQuota: Points-based system (daily request count limits deprecated). See https://docs.cjdropshipping.com/en/api/api2/standard/points.html
rateLimits.ipUserCap: max 3 API users per IP address

cjdropshipping.notes: Fully public developer API requiring only a CJ account and API key — no special partner approval needed for the catalog search endpoints. Account registration at cjdropshipping.com unlocks API key access. Rate tier is tied to CJ account sales volume level. Product-level affiliate/trackable link generation via API is unverified and needs manual confirmation against official docs.

zendrop.publicApiScope: Zendrop exposes api.zendrop.com but the domain is fully behind login authentication — no unauthenticated developer documentation, no public OpenAPI spec, and no public developer portal is reachable without credentials. Their help center (support.zendrop.com) covers only UI-based product discovery workflows. No public product catalog search API was found via official documentation or their developer domain.

auth.todo: api.zendrop.com redirects to a login page. Auth model (API key, OAuth, etc.) is not publicly documented. Contact Zendrop's partner/integrations team for private API access.

zendrop.notes: Zendrop's product catalog is accessible only through their web UI or potentially through a private partner API not publicly documented. The api.zendrop.com endpoint exists but requires authenticated access. Integration would require a direct partnership or reseller agreement with Zendrop to obtain API credentials and documentation. Do not attempt to reverse-engineer or scrape.

recommendation: AliExpress is already integrated and production-ready via the official Affiliate Open Platform (keyword search + image smartmatch + affiliate link generation — all confirmed from codebase). CJ Dropshipping has a fully public developer API with a documented product catalog search endpoint (/product/listV2) requiring only a free CJ account and API key — it is the most straightforward new integration. Zendrop has no discoverable public product catalog API; their api.zendrop.com is fully login-gated with no public documentation, making integration impossible without a direct partnership agreement — do not pursue without first obtaining explicit partner API access from Zendrop.
